recommendation: Use FLUX.2 Klein 4B as the inexpensive default for representative wardrobe images. It finished all eight cases with a median generation time of 0.72 seconds. Review the preview: it missed the V neckline, made the blazer checks too bold, and rendered the belt like a short strap. Use a real photo plus background removal when matching a specific owned garment matters. Nano Banana 2 followed details most consistently here, but costs about 64 times as much at this size and cropped the belt.
limits: One output per model per case; subjective visual screening, not a statistical quality or latency benchmark. Identical prompts and cleanup. Model seeds do not create equivalent samples across providers. No comparison against an owned source photograph. Provider prices and predict-time charges are estimates, not invoice reconciliation.

klein.summary: Best price/speed. Check neckline, belt proportions, and subtle patterns.

pimage.summary: Convincing fabric and good basics. Belt includes props; blazer misses the requested windowpane.

schnell.summary: Low cost, less reliable detail following. Blazer generated without sleeves; stripes too broad.

banana2.summary: Most consistent requested details in this set. Belt is cropped; higher cost and latency.
